description: This file contains the implementation of the MainActivity class for an Android application, which manages the app's main user interface, menu options, and logging setup. It initializes fragments, handles menu interactions to toggle logging visibility, and sets up a custom logging chain.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity class for an Android application, responsible for initializing UI components, managing fragment transactions, menu interactions, and setting up logging chains.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, inflates the layout, and loads the default fragment if no saved instance state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML resource.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the menu by updating the visibility and title of the log toggle menu item based on the current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log display and updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up a chain of logging components to handle on-screen logging and message filtering.
